content.text:
I submitted **index 13 (Sb fraction 0.448)**. It had the highest EQE I measured, 0.101%. I used all 5 EQE measurements; the XRD budget went unused.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0.350 | 0.092 |
| **13** | **0.448** | **0.101** |
| 15 | 0.519 | 0.091 |
| 20 | 0.675 | −0.002 |
| 25 | 0.798 | 0.004 |

- **Sb-rich side:** I started near Sb 0.67, the composition of the known NiSb₂O₆ crystal structure. Both measurements on this side gave essentially zero EQE.
- **Middle of the line:** EQE was about 0.09% at both 0.35 and 0.52, and a little higher at 0.448. That suggests a broad peak somewhere between about 0.35 and 0.52.

**What could be missed:**
- **Low-Sb end:** I measured nothing below Sb 0.35 (indices 0–9), so a higher value there can't be ruled out.
- **Small differences:** The three mid-range values are close (0.091–0.101%). The true best composition could be a neighbour of index 13, such as index 12 or 14, which I didn't measure.
- **Phase check:** I didn't run XRD, so I haven't confirmed which crystal phases are present in the active region.
